# Muhammad Fadhil Al Amal

> Muhammad Fadhil Al Amal is an AI & software engineer based in Banda Aceh, Indonesia. He has 5+ years building and maintaining a healthcare SaaS platform at Kelola.net (CodeIgniter 3 / PHP, MySQL 8.0, REST API, Docker) that serves hundreds of clinics across Indonesia, and researches NLP for Indonesian regional languages. He also speaks at workshops on practical AI for office administration.

The site is bilingual: Indonesian is the default (`/`) and English lives under `/en/`. All technical articles are written in Indonesian.

## Profile

- [Home — Bahasa Indonesia](https://mfa-labs.github.io/): Full portfolio — engineering case studies, research, publications, workshops, and projects.
- [Home — English](https://mfa-labs.github.io/en/): English version of the same portfolio.
- [Technical blog](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/): 10 long-form articles on healthcare SaaS engineering, interoperability, and infrastructure.
- [RSS feed](https://mfa-labs.github.io/rss.xml): Feed for the technical blog.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-fadhil-al-amal/): Professional profile.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=1pAz6xgAAAAJ&hl=id): Publication record.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/mfa-labs): Code and projects.

## Technical Articles

All articles are first-hand engineering write-ups from a production healthcare SaaS platform (Indonesian language).

- [Migrasi PHP 7 ke PHP 8](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/php7-to-php8-migration/): Migrating a live SaaS platform from PHP 7 to PHP 8.1 with no downtime across hundreds of clinics.
- [Menghubungkan Klinik ke SATUSEHAT](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/satusehat-integration/): Integrating a clinic platform with Indonesia's national health data exchange (OAuth2, REST API, ICD-10, ICD-9).
- [Sistem Notifikasi WhatsApp & CRM](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/whatsapp-notification-crm/): From legacy cron notifications to a modern CRM module with a template engine.
- [Arsitektur Multi-Tenant & 12 Role](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/multi-tenant-role-architecture/): Multi-tenant data isolation and role-based routing across 12 user roles.
- [Rekam Medis Elektronik & Alur Kerja Klinik](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/medical-records-clinical-workflow/): Digital odontogram, ICD coding, appointment booking, and cross-clinic record sharing.
- [Sistem Laporan Keuangan & Jasa Medis](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/financial-reporting-jasmedis/): Multi-role financial reporting and medical fee-splitting calculations.
- [Sistem Pembayaran & Kasir](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/billing-kasir/): Multi-method payments, invoicing, and debt tracking.
- [Infrastruktur & DevOps](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/infrastructure-devops/): Server management, hosting migration, and Docker containerization.
- [Optimasi Database & Performa](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/database-performance-optimization/): Indexing, query optimization, and a memory-leak fix for millions of transactions.
- [SIBUNDA — Aplikasi Monitoring Gizi & Pencegahan Stunting](https://mfa-labs.github.io/blog/sibunda/): Flutter + Node.js REST API mobile app for child nutrition monitoring and stunting prevention, built with the Faculty of Nursing, Syiah Kuala University.

## Workshops & Talks

Slide decks, documentation, and source code from workshops delivered by Muhammad Fadhil Al Amal.

- [AI-Powered Digital Archive System](https://mfa-labs.github.io/materi/workshop-ai-sekre.html): Workshop for the D3 Secretarial Study Programme, Faculty of Economics and Business, Syiah Kuala University (16 September 2026) on building an AI-powered digital archive with Google Form, Drive, Apps Script, and OpenRouter.
- [Smart Archive — Apps Script documentation](https://mfa-labs.github.io/materi/smart-archive/): Setup guide and full source code for that workshop — Google Form → Google Drive → Apps Script → OpenRouter → Google Sheets, including the OpenRouter API key setup script.
- [AI Bukan Sekadar ChatGPT](https://mfa-labs.github.io/materi/workshop-ai-tendik-sesi2.html): Session 2 of the workshop on AI archive innovation for study-programme education staff (7 July 2026) — Claude vs ChatGPT, cost strategy, and building tools with Gemini Canvas.
- [SIBUNDA project](https://mfa-labs.github.io/#projek): Community-service mobile app monitoring child nutrition against WHO growth standards (2025–2026).

## Teaching

Course materials from undergraduate teaching at Universitas Ahmad Dahlan Aceh, Faculty of Science and Technology. Course pages are written in Indonesian.

- [All course materials](https://mfa-labs.github.io/kuliah/): Listing of courses taught in the Informatics Study Programme (S1).
- [Algoritma dan Pemrograman I](https://mfa-labs.github.io/kuliah/algoritma-dan-pemrograman-1/): Introductory algorithms and programming course (INFUAD-003, 2 credits, odd semester 2026/2027) — a 16-week schedule covering computational thinking, pseudocode, flowcharts, data concepts, operators, selection, iteration, and an algorithm design mini project.
